text: {"lessons":["Selling a position just because it has a gain can cut short further upside; base decisions on its prospects and portfolio risk, not the comfort of locking in profit.","A short-term account decline is not by itself a reason to trade; review the evidence and avoid reacting to daily fluctuations.","My repeated sales of Stocks B and D have reduced those positions, so consider diversification and target allocations rather than focusing only on gains relative to average cost."]}
